python-programming--variable.title: a name can be rebound to another type
python-programming--variable.note: Assigning again rebinds the name to a new object of another type; no declaration fixes it.

python-programming--slicing.title: slice bounds and step
python-programming--slicing.note: start is inclusive, stop is exclusive, and a step of -1 walks the sequence backwards.

python-programming--tuple.title: ordering and mutability of built-in collections
python-programming--tuple.note: Only the container is frozen: a tuple holding a list still exposes that list's mutations.

python-programming--try-except.title: catching ValueError
python-programming--try-except.note: int() raises ValueError for non-numeric text; the except clause catches that type instead of crashing.

python-programming--finally-clause.title: finally runs even on return
python-programming--finally-clause.note: The finally block runs after the return value is computed but before the caller receives it.

python-programming--class.title: class, constructor and method
python-programming--class.note: The class body defines the constructor and norm; Point(3, 4) creates an instance and binds self to it.

python-programming--inheritance.title: subclassing and overriding
python-programming--inheritance.note: Dog names Animal in parentheses to inherit its methods, then replaces speak with its own version.

python-programming--re-search.title: searching anywhere in a string
python-programming--re-search.note: re.search scans the whole string; the match object exposes the matched text and its starting offset.

python-programming--with-statement.title: context manager closes the file
python-programming--with-statement.note: The with block closes the file when it exits, even if the write raises an exception.

python-programming--pickling.title: json versus pickle
rows: null, bool, number, string, list, object
python-programming--pickling.note: json is a cross-language interchange format; pickle preserves Python objects but must never load untrusted bytes.

python-programming--mainloop.title: starting the Tk event loop
python-programming--mainloop.note: mainloop enters Tk's event loop; the window stays responsive until it is destroyed.

python-programming--ndarray.title: shape and dtype
python-programming--ndarray.note: shape gives the length along each axis; dtype is the one type shared by every element.

python-programming--groupby.title: split, apply, combine
python-programming--groupby.note: groupby splits rows by dept, averages marks in each group, and combines the results into a Series.

python-programming--axes.title: Figure and Axes from subplots
python-programming--axes.note: subplots returns a Figure and one Axes; the Axes holds the data and labels while the Figure owns the output.
